title: Quiz: EXPLAIN and Query Tuning
description: Check your understanding of EXPLAIN and Query Tuning.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: Why does WHERE YEAR(created_at)=2024 prevent index use?
questions.correctAnswer: The function wraps the column — the index sees transformed values

questions.question: True or False: Rewrite as created_at >= ... AND < ... to keep the index usable.
What is the main purpose of the EXPLAIN and Query Tuning technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you explain and query tuning effectively.

questions.question: In SQL, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
